hotels.title: Stylish Paris Eiffel Tower Stay in the Heart of the 15th Arrondissement
hotels.description: Just a short stroll from the Eiffel Tower and the Champ de Mars, this polished Paris address places you in the 15th arrondissement, close to the Seine and the elegant avenues of the Left Bank. The nearby Bir-Hakeim bridge and Trocadéro are easy to reach on foot, while the metro opens up the city with ease. Inside, contemporary rooms offer a calm counterpoint to the capital’s grandeur, with many looking towards the tower or landscaped courtyard. Le Jardin serves French dishes in a bright setting, while the bar is a handy stop for a drink before heading to Rue Cler or the cafés of Saint-Germain-des-Prés

hotels.title: Stylish Paris Montparnasse Escape with Contemporary Pullman Flair
hotels.description: Rising above the 14th arrondissement, this polished Paris address places you near Montparnasse station and the boutiques of Rue de Rennes. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping city views, while the sleek interiors pair contemporary design with a distinctly Parisian edge. Dine at Umami Burger Paris for gourmet burgers and cocktails, or head to Skybar Paris on the 32nd floor for panoramic views across the capital. Nearby, the Catacombs, Luxembourg Gardens and Saint-Germain-des-Prés offer a refined route through the city’s cultural heart
